posts.zh:
dsh-client-ui-theme-xp 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Windows XP Luna 桌面化主题：浮动窗口管理器（任务栏、桌面图标）加上还原度很高的 Luna 皮肤。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7d61e2854e5ace2d81ce.html
posts.en:
dsh-client-ui-theme-xp is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Windows XP Luna desktop for the DSH Web UI: a floating window manager with taskbar and desktop icons, plus the era-accurate Luna skin.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7d61e2854e5ace2d81ce.html
